name: brokerforboat
description: Create, publish and manage boat listings and buyer leads for yacht brokers from ChatGPT, through the BrokerForBoat MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Connect ChatGPT to BrokerForBoat, the CRM for yacht brokers. Create boat listings from notes or spec sheets with texts in each of your languages, add photos, and publish them on your WordPress website and the boat portals (Boat24, TodoBarco, Band of Boats, Yachtall and more). Follow up on buyer enquiries: see what you have today, read conversations, save draft replies for review, add notes and tasks, move leads through your pipeline and check your lead statistics. New listings are always drafts and emails are never sent by ChatGPT.
defaultPrompt: Create a draft listing for this boat from my notes.
How many leads did we get in the last 90 days, and from which portals?
